full_judgment:
Fatema Najib, J: On an application under Article 102 of the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh filed by the petitioner, a Rule Nisi was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the inaction of the respondents to take action to comply the sections 3(3)(4) and 17(Gha) of the Local Government (Pourashava) Ain, 2009 as well as letter dated 17-10-2021 vide their Memo No. 05.55.8500.011. 06.016.21-996 (Annexure-G to the Writ Petition) and also as to why the respondents should not be directed to published final Gazettee for expansion of border of Pourashava of Prigonj Upazilla, District-Rangpur with updated voter list and/or such other or further order or orders passed as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. The relevant facts for the purpose of disposal of the Rule are that on 1-3-2021 a Gazettee notification has been published vide SRO No. 51-Ain/2021 dated 25-2-2021 under the signature of the respondent No. 3 for expansion of border of Pourashava of Pirgonj Upazilla, District-Rangpur that Union No. 9 with four Mouza, Union No. 8 with one Mouza, Union No. 12 part of one Mouza and Union No. 13 with also part of one Mouza with a view to declare City of Pourashava under District Rangpur. In the aforesaid notification it has been expressed that if the aggrieved person have any objection against the said opinion for expansion of Pourashava, they can file objection within less than one month and the Government would dispose of the said objection within 3(three) months. A certificate was issued by the Upazilla Porishongkhan Officer, Pirgonj, Rangpur to the effect that total people of aforesaid 6 Mouzas are 10,419. Further Deputy Commissioner, Rangpur issued a letter vide Memo No. 05.55.8500.011.05.006.20-334 dated 16-3-2021 to the petitioner Nos. 1, 3, 4 and 5 stating that if they have any objection against the inclusion of area in the aforesaid Gazettee notification, they may file objection in writing within one month from the date of publication of Gazettee notification to the Deputy Commissioner. Then the petitioner No. 1 filed an application on 18-3-2021 to the respondent No. 4 to exclude Union No. 8 from Pourashava (Annexure-C to the Writ Petition). 

 4. A circular vide Memo No.17.00.000.034. 38.022.20-488 dated 14-10-2021 (Annexure-H to the Writ Petition) was issued declaring schedule for executing election fixing date 28-11-2021. The boundary of Pourashava has been expanded but voter list under the said Gazettee notification has not yet been published and due to which the people of the Gazeetted Union Parishad will be deprived from casting their vote since Pourashava election will be held with the voters who are listed under Gazette notification dated 18-2-2016. 

 5. The voters under Gazettee notification dated 18-2-2016 exercised their voting rights peacefully and enjoyed the privilege of Pourashava facilities. But due to impugned Gazettee notification dated 17-10-2021 the people of Union Nos. 8, 9, 12 and 13 are being deprived from casting their vote which are their constitutional rights. On these grounds the petitioners filed writ petition dated 15-11-2021 praying that the Gazettee notification published on 1-3-2021 vide SRO No. 51-Ain/2021 dated 25-2-2021 be declared as illegal, void and in violation of section 3(1) and (2) of the Local Government (Pourashava) Ain, 2009. 

 10. In the present main writ application the Rule has been issued on the following: (a) the Gazettee notification published on 1-3-2021 vide SRO No. 51-Ain/2011 dated 12th Falgun Bangla/25th February, 2021 for expansion of border of Pourashava of Pirgonj Upazilla be declared illegal, void and violation of section 3(1) and (2) of Local Government (Pourashava) Ain, 2009. 

 12. Now, we are to focus on the Supplementary Rule dated 24-5-2022. Since Gazettee notification for expansion of boundary of Pourashava of Pirgonj dated 1-3-2021 vide SRO No. 51-Ain/2011 dated 12th Falgun Bangla/ 25th February, 2021 is not finally published and due to which the petitioners have been deprived from casting their vote as voter under Local Government (Pourashava) Ain, 2009 which violates their fundamental rights guaranteed in Article 11 of the Constitution. Article 11 of the Constitution contemplates that—“প্রজাতন্ত্র হইবে একটি গণতন্ত্র, যেখানে মৌলিক মানবাধিকার ও স্বাধীনতার নিশ্চয়তা থাকিবে, মানবসত্তার মর্যাদা ও মূল্যের প্রতি শ্রদ্ধাবোধ নিশ্চিত হইবে এবং প্রশাসনের সকল পর্যায়ে নির্বাচিত প্রতিনিধিদের মাধ্যমে জনাগণের কার্যকর অংশগ্রহণ নিশ্চিত হইবে।”
